title: A label grows to fit what it says
goal: Make a piece of text narrower, or give a copy of a component different wording, and the words re-wrap but the box around them stays the size it was, so the last line is cut off or the label hangs over the shape behind it. A text box should re-measure itself: change its width or its words and its height follows, and anything arranging it re-flows around the new height.
notes: The measuring already exists: TextRasterizer.naturalSize(_:maxWidth:minWidth:) wraps and returns the frame the words need, and EditorState.commitTextEdit and restyleSelectedText both use it. What is missing is a re-measure on the two paths that change a text layer without going through those: a width change (canvas resize handles in CanvasView, typed W in the geometry fields, and a container stretching a child through GroupFlow) and a wording override (Document.setInstanceOverride, ComponentProperties.swift:498, stores the string and never touches the frame). PhotonzCore is pure and cannot call CoreText, so the measurement is injected the way StarterComponents.layer(kind, measure:) already does. Re-measure has to land inside the same History.perform as the edit so it stays one undo step, and before reflowLayouts so a stack closes up in the same step. Evidence: ui-building.md What the first version deliberately does not do (first bullet and A text override does not resize its instance), plus the rough lines in queue/audits/2026-09-03-ui-components-placement.json (Nothing re-wraps) and 2026-09-03-auto-layout.json. Related: the open p3 task a-text-block-is-the-same-size-while-you-type-it is a different bug in the same code (the draft font metrics while typing versus the committed frame); whoever gets there first should read the other.
acceptance: Dragging a text layer narrower re-wraps its words and grows its height, so no line is cut off
Typing a new width in the position and size fields does the same, in one undo step
A label inside a stack that gains a line pushes the rows below it down on its own
A copy of a component given longer wording shows all of it rather than cutting it off
Moving a text layer, or changing anything that is not its width or its words, does not resize it

Try it with Groups that arrange their own contents and Make a component turned on in Experiments: draw a label on a screen, drag its right edge left until it wraps, then stack it with two boxes and retype it longer
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task

log.note: review before building: the three broken paths were reproduced first, as failing tests. The canvas handle drag ALREADY re-wrapped (CanvasView.resizedFrame), so acceptance 1 was half true; typed W, a stack stretching a child, and a wording override were the three that were not.

review before building: rejected a diff-based re-measure pass in History (compare the doc before and after and re-fit whatever changed) because a copy is rebuilt from its original every sync, so the copy's re-measured height would be thrown away and re-derived on every edit. Did it at the source instead: Layer.resized(to:) is the ONE place a layer is handed a new box, so the typed W field, GroupFlow's stretch and LayerScaling all get it from one change.

built: TextMeasurement (new, PhotonzCore) is the injected measurer, installed in PhotonzApp.init from TextRasterizer.naturalSize; a whole-word estimate stands in everywhere else so tests are deterministic. Layer.textHugsItsWords / textRefitted carry the hug-vs-wrap rule.

built: Layer.resized(to:) re-measures height when the WIDTH changed and leaves the box alone otherwise, so moving does not resize. ComponentProperties.apply re-fits on a wording override, anchored by the container's contentPlacement (threaded through mutate) so a centred label stays centred. reflowLayouts now runs to a fixed point (cap 3) because a stack places rows from the sizes they had going in; History.perform reflows again after syncComponentInstances when a copy actually changed.

found by playtesting, not in the task: a copy of a component did not carry its original's layout or contentPlacement, so a copy of a stack was a heap and did not close up around its grown label. Fixed in ComponentInstances (both insert and sync) with a test.

review before ready: playtested on the probe (Scripts/playtest/label-grows-walk.json, Screen Recording granted). All six acceptance scenarios verified on the real window. Three rough edges left and filed: typed W has no floor, the H field is blank rather than dimmed, vertical Stretch on text now does nothing.

behaviour change to know about: a text child inside a scaled group no longer has its height multiplied, it takes the height its words need. Four LayerScalingTests asserted the old lie and were rewritten. Documented in docs/design/ui-building.md under 'A label grows to fit what it says'.

Text boxes re-measure: width change re-wraps and re-heights (Layer.resized), a wording override re-fits a copy's label (hug vs wrap), reflowLayouts runs to a fixed point and again after copies refill, and a copy now carries its original's layout. Measurement injected via TextMeasurement so PhotonzCore stays pure. Verified by 11 new tests (2308 green) and a real probe walk with Screen Recording granted; audit at queue/audits/2026-09-03-label-grows.json; three rough edges filed as p3.
